support_claim: Unresolved-preservation evidence blocks closure because legal has not established which registry entity is the contracting party, despite naming variants between CRM and billing.

propositions.proposition: CRM account NBA-102 is recorded with the name "Northbridge Analytics" (not "Northbridge Analytics Inc.").
propositions.relevance: Characterizes the left referent crm:NBA-102 as a CRM account labeled "Northbridge Analytics".

propositions.proposition: Billing records use the billed name "Northbridge Analytics Inc."
propositions.relevance: Characterizes the right referent billing:Northbridge Analytics Inc. as the name appearing on billing documents.

propositions.proposition: Sales uses the short name "Northbridge Analytics" while billing and the MSA use "Northbridge Analytics Inc."
propositions.relevance: Documents naming variants across systems but does not establish legal identity between the CRM account and the billing entity.

propositions.proposition: A 2024 credit check returned a Wyoming LLC named "Northbridge Analytics LLC".
propositions.relevance: Introduces an additional registry entity candidate, preventing closure on a single legal counterparty.

propositions.proposition: Legal has not determined which registry entity is the contracting party.
propositions.relevance: The packet explicitly states that contracting-party identity cannot be established.

propositions.proposition: The registry link should be treated as unresolved.
